description.value: Indian Roti Kitchen bills itself as Vancouver's first East Indian roti shop, serving a focused menu of roti wraps filled with classic Indian curries — from dal and channa to butter chicken and lamb vindaloo. The Cambie Street location operates as a takeout-only spot, making it a quick and hearty refuelling option for cyclists passing through the neighbourhood. The menu features an extensive vegetarian section alongside meat and shrimp options.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 4m; stands (2 spaces) at 19m; stands (4 spaces) at 50m; stands (8 spaces, covered) at 51m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 75m. Total: 20 spaces.
